reviews.query: How do I submit a return request on the Tiki app and schedule the free courier pickup?
reviews.text: To submit a return or exchange request, go to 'Account' > 'Order Management' in the Tiki app and select the order with 'Delivered' status. Tap 'Request Return/Exchange', select your reason, and upload 3-5 clear photos or a video showing the product defect. Once your request is received, a courier will pick up the item from your address for free within 1-2 business days, or you may choose to drop off the package at a designated Tiki partner post office.

claims.proposition: App navigation through Account, Order Management, Delivered order and Request Return/Exchange.
Select reason and upload 3-5 clear photos or a defect video.
Free courier pickup within 1-2 business days after request receipt.
Dropoff at designated partner post offices is an alternative.

reviews.query: What are the requirements for refund approval and are shipping fees refunded if I return due to personal preference?
reviews.text: Refund requests are processed only if an order is successfully canceled prior to dispatch, or once the Tiki warehouse receives and inspects the returned product to standard. Please note that all refund decisions must undergo reconciliation by authorized customer service personnel. Regarding your query on shipping fees, original shipping fees are non-refundable if the return reason is based on personal preference.

reviews.query: Where can I check my refund tracking status and transaction tracing code on Tiki?
reviews.text: You can monitor the progress of your refund by navigating to 'Account Details' > 'Return & Refund Management' on Tiki. In this section, you can view your refund status, such as 'Reconciliation Processing', 'Transferred to Bank', or 'Refund Succeeded'. Once the status is 'Refund Succeeded', the bank's transaction tracing reference code will be available for you to view.

reviews.query: My bank account was debited but my order status on Tiki still shows Awaiting Payment.
reviews.text: If your bank account or e-wallet is debited but your order status remains 'Awaiting Payment', this is typically due to transmission latency from the payment gateway. The Tiki system and payment gateway usually reconcile and update the order status automatically within 15-30 minutes. If your order remains unconfirmed after 1 hour, the system will automatically refund the original payment account within 24-72 business hours.

claims.proposition: Gateway transmission latency is the typical cause of debited-but-awaiting-payment incidents.
Reconciliation and status update occur within the cited 15-30 minute window.
